core.headline: Hollybank, Pilgrims Way, Wrotham TN15
core.summary: Detached house on approximately 2.1 acres with indoor swimming pool and triple garage, set within the Kent Downs National Landscape. Guide Price £1,250,000 freehold.
core.listing:
Hollybank is a detached four-bedroom house positioned on approximately 2.1 acres within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. The property was built in 1987 and includes an indoor swimming pool and triple garage.

The accommodation comprises three reception rooms arranged over the ground floor. The principal rooms offer the proportions and ceiling heights typical of their period.

The kitchen is supplemented by separate family space. A utility room provides additional working areas.

Four bedrooms are arranged over the first floor. The principal bedroom is served by an en suite bathroom. A family bathroom and a further bathroom serve the remaining bedrooms.

The grounds extend to approximately 2.1 acres. An indoor swimming pool occupies a separate structure within the plot. The triple garage provides covered parking; additional parking is available on the driveway.

Pilgrims Way connects Wrotham to surrounding villages and the wider road network. Wrotham lies within the Borough of Tonbridge and Malling.

Guide Price £1,250,000 for the freehold. Council Tax Band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating D. Construction is standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and oil-fired central heating are connected. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking on the driveway. The property lies within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. Building safety, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining issues: none known.
